paragraphs.text: Pedal & Pillows was welcomed by the Pontotoc County Chamber Main Street in a ribbon-cutting announcement posted Tuesday, November 3.
The Chamber described the business as a new short-term lodging cottage on Oxford Street in Pontotoc, offering a place for visitors to stay.
